# PHP API Builder Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Backend > PHP

## Overview

Builds RESTful APIs with PHP using Laravel or Symfony with proper resource design, authentication, and API versioning

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [php-api-builder-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
php-api-builder-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@php-api-builder` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Build RESTful APIs with resource controllers
- Implement API authentication with tokens
- Configure API versioning strategies
- Add rate limiting and throttling

## Technology Standards Applied

- **RESTful API Design**: REST conventions for PHP APIs
- **Laravel Sanctum**: SPA and mobile API authentication
- **OpenAPI**: API documentation specification
